issues.description: The Note.creationDate field has inconsistent types across artifacts: the template's common model defines creationDate as java.time.Instant, while the solution's common model defines it as String. Additionally, the solution's NoteService still calls note.setCreationDate(Instant.now()), which does not match the solution Note model's setter signature. This mismatch (Instant vs String) exists between the common model and service code and will cause compilation/runtime issues and confusion about the intended type for creationDate.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose a single, consistent type for Note.creationDate across common model and server/service code. Preferably change the solution's common Note.creationDate back to java.time.Instant (and its getter/setter accordingly) so NoteService can set Instant.now(), or alternatively change NoteService to set a String (e.g. Instant.now().toString()) and ensure the common model uses String everywhere. Update any JSON serialization configuration if necessary so client/server exchange remains consistent.
